text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Your delicate handling 
was truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because the prey does not move, 
it presents its own distinct challenge—and 
appeal.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Especially the tactical maneuvering 
required when their vitals are obscured!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help letting out a gasp... 
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Had this been an actual hunt, 
the prey would surely have fled.
